verdict.rationale: The pack never states the RX 9070 XT's VRAM capacity or memory bandwidth. The only memory figure, "up to 48GB of VRAM," describes Radeon workstations in general, not this card. ROCm support for llama.cpp and vLLM on gfx1201 shows inference software exists, but nothing shows this GPU has the memory to make 70B-class quantized inference practical.
